vetSays.line: 👥 A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek walks out with A person, maybe 20s, with a nervous tic. "Nobody walks alone today."
A man, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going." The pantry won't fill itself.
🚶 A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek is back with A person, maybe 20s, with a nervous tic.
💧 A man, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +2 clean.

🛡️ A man, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm catches you eyeing the bark plates — claw-scored, vine-laced. "...Want to actually SEE one?" They talk you through it — wide strips dried flat, laced overlapping like shingles, snug but not tight. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.

"Hey." A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek.)
"You haven't earned that yet," A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek says. (Trust too low.)
"You haven't earned that yet," A man, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm says. (Trust too low.)
A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
A man, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
👂 Overheard — A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek: "That snare line needs checking. Talk later, work now."
A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
You give A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek 3 portions of Dried beans, with the village watching. They look at you differently now.
👂 Overheard — A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek: "We need more firewood before dark. Who's with me?"
A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits."
You catch fragments by the fire — Hayden telling A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek about you. Someone's added a flourish that wasn't there this morning.
📋 A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek — 🪾 Gather deadfall. They'll report back by next part.
🍂 A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek gathers deadfall — 1 stick + 1 fiber. The pile grows. (4 sticks now.)
A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek is showing Owen how to tie a snare. Hands patient. It takes three tries.
You catch fragments by the fire — A person, maybe 40s telling A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek about you. It's picking up decorations as it travels.
💧 A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +3 clean.
📋 A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek — 🪾 Gather deadfall. They'll report back by next part.
🍂 A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek gathers deadfall — 1 stick. The pile grows. (4 sticks now.)
A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek came back with 522 kcal of something edible. The pantry breathes.
👥 A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek walks out with Hayden. "Nobody walks alone today."
You catch fragments by the fire — Wyatt telling A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek about you. It's barely the same story now. That's what fires do.
You catch fragments by the fire — Jude telling A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek about you. The story's getting bigger than what happened.
🚶 A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek is back with Hayden.
the person in their 30s, with a scarred cheek spent the afternoon at the workbench, and the Crossbow bolt came apart in their hands. The materials are wasted.

You catch fragments by the fire — Nikos telling A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek about you. The truth left this story two fires ago. What's left is better theater.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Wyatt, Hayden, Sanh, Yara and Nikos met them at the door — 3 put down, 2 driven off. Sanh, Yara, Nikos are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Hayden just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sanh just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Hayden, Jude, Sanh, Mats and Yara met them at the door — 2 put down, 3 barely walked away. Hayden, Jude, Yara are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mats just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
